heading_en: Submission of an Application for Approval
summary_ja: 承認申請書の記載事項と添付書類を定める。
summary_en: Specifies the contents of the application for approval under Article 217, paragraph (1) and the documents to be attached.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach seeking the approval under Article 217, paragraph (1) shall submit to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency an application for approval stating the following matters: (i) trade name; (ii) the name and title of the person responsible for ascertaining and managing the capital adequacy ratio.

The following documents shall be attached to the application for approval under the preceding paragraph: (i) a statement of reasons; (ii) a résumé of the person responsible prescribed in item (ii) of the preceding paragraph; (iii) documents showing that the exposure fluctuation estimation model and its operation conform to the standards for approval; (iv) other documents stating matters that would serve as a useful reference.
